meta.note: The single source of truth. Colours, font sizes and radii are used only through these names (pump.design); tests/test_design_tokens.py enforces it.

tokens.name: window-bg
tokens.usage: App and window background (QMainWindow/QWidget). Ground for body-text (11.5:1) and subtle-text (5.2:1).

tokens.name: canvas-bg
tokens.usage: Node-canvas background behind the dotted grid.

tokens.name: grid-dot
tokens.usage: Minor dots of the canvas grid; also the hairline under the toolbar and menu bar and around toolbox items, recent/example rows and tables.

tokens.name: grid-dot-strong
tokens.usage: Major (every-Nth) dots of the canvas grid.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Toolbars, menus, status bar, dialogs, inputs, tables and node bodies.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate row inside a node body.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Toolbox dock, welcome content and welcome panel backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Tool buttons, table header cells and the info banner background.

tokens.name: mono-bg
tokens.usage: Monospace blocks (coefficients, pump list).

tokens.name: dock-title-bg
tokens.usage: Dock widget title bar.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline around containers that do not need to be found to be used: menus, dialogs, nodes, toolbox items. 1.6:1 on surface is fine for decoration; controls use control-border.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, spin boxes, combos and unchecked checkboxes: 3.3:1 on surface, 3.0:1 on surface-sunken (the 3:1 floor for control borders). Replaces border and border-check on controls (1.6:1 and 1.9:1).

tokens.name: disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a disabled input, spin box or combo.

tokens.name: disabled-text
tokens.usage: Text of disabled inputs, field labels and checkboxes (state shown by the greyed field too).

tokens.name: disabled-border
tokens.usage: Outline of a disabled input or checkbox.

tokens.name: check-mark
tokens.usage: Tick drawn inside a checked checkbox on accent.

tokens.name: border-tool-button
tokens.usage: Tool button outline.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Horizontal rules in dialogs (#HLine) and the mono-block border.

tokens.name: gridline
tokens.usage: Table grid lines.

tokens.name: header-divider
tokens.usage: Vertical separators between table header cells.

tokens.name: title-bg
tokens.usage: Steel title bar of processing nodes, dialog headers and the welcome header. title-text on it is 11.6:1.

tokens.name: title-bg-source
tokens.usage: Lighter steel-blue title bar of source nodes (no inputs) and their dialog headers. title-text on it is 5.3:1.

tokens.name: title-text
tokens.usage: Node and dialog titles on title-bg and title-bg-source.

tokens.name: header-button-border
tokens.usage: Outline of the Maximize / Restore button on title-bg.

tokens.name: header-button-hover-bg
tokens.usage: Maximize / Restore button hover fill on title-bg.

tokens.name: header-button-hover-border
tokens.usage: Maximize / Restore button hover outline.

tokens.name: header-subtitle
tokens.usage: Dialog and welcome subtitles on title-bg (7.4:1). Dialog headers are always title-bg; never set it on title-bg-source (3.4:1).

tokens.name: node-shadow
tokens.usage: Drop shadow painted under canvas nodes.

tokens.name: body-text
tokens.usage: Default text on window-bg (11.5:1) and surface (13:1); node body text.

tokens.name: subtle-text
tokens.usage: Status bar and dock text, secondary node text, on surface (5.9:1) and surface-sunken (5.5:1).

tokens.name: field-label
tokens.usage: Form field labels and checkbox text on surface (9.5:1).

tokens.name: unit-label
tokens.usage: Unit suffixes beside inputs (m³/h, m, kW) and the example descriptions: 4.9:1 on surface, 4.5:1 on surface-sunken. Darkened from #8a96a3 (3.0:1) in the design-system formalisation.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Italic empty-state text on the welcome panel: 4.5:1 on surface-sunken. Was #a0aab4 (2.2:1).

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Section labels (uppercase, tracked) and table header text: 5.5:1 on surface, 4.9:1 on surface-muted, 4.5:1 on dock-title-bg; TestPointSet ports. Darkened from #5b7185 (4.2:1 on dock-title-bg).

tokens.name: mono-text
tokens.usage: Text inside monospace blocks on mono-bg (9.8:1).

tokens.name: selected-text
tokens.usage: Text of selected menu items, table rows and hovered recent/example rows (7:1+ on their tints).

tokens.name: tool-button-text
tokens.usage: Tool button labels on surface-muted (10.9:1).

tokens.name: table-computed-text
tokens.usage: Read-only computed cells (head, efficiency) in the Test Points table, on table-computed-bg (4.8:1).

tokens.name: table-computed-bg
tokens.usage: Background of read-only computed table cells.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Industrial blue: primary buttons, focus borders, checked checkboxes, hover borders, selected-node outline, active edges and the RatedPoint port. White on it is 5.2:1. Lives in both style.py and canvas/theme.py: change both together.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill and its border (white on it 6.1:1).

tokens.name: hover-bg
tokens.usage: Hover fill of toolbar buttons and menu-bar items.

tokens.name: menu-selected-bg
tokens.usage: Hovered/selected item in a dropdown menu, with selected-text.

tokens.name: tool-button-hover-bg
tokens.usage: Tool button hover fill (border turns accent).

tokens.name: toolbox-hover-bg
tokens.usage: Toolbox item hover fill (border turns accent).

tokens.name: row-hover-bg
tokens.usage: Hovered recent-file and example rows on the welcome dialog.

tokens.name: selection-bg
tokens.usage: Text selection inside inputs.

tokens.name: table-selection-bg
tokens.usage: Selected table rows, with selected-text.

tokens.name: scrollbar
tokens.usage: Scrollbar handle.

tokens.name: scrollbar-hover
tokens.usage: Scrollbar handle on hover.

tokens.name: ok-green
tokens.usage: Canvas accent for a successful/pass state.

tokens.name: reject-red
tokens.usage: Canvas accent for a rejected/fail state.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Canvas accent for a warning state.

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Warning text on surface, e.g. the Compliance 'unverified criteria' line (6.1:1). amber itself is a canvas fill only (3.0:1 as text).

tokens.name: info-button
tokens.usage: The (i) help button: outline and glyph, white glyph on hover. Was #5b8def (3.2:1).

tokens.name: banner-info-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the info banner and the idle verdict.

tokens.name: banner-info-text
tokens.usage: Info banner text on banner-info-bg (6.7:1).

tokens.name: banner-ok-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the ok banner and the PASS verdict.

tokens.name: banner-ok-text
tokens.usage: Ok banner and PASS verdict text on banner-ok-bg (5.5:1).

tokens.name: banner-ok-border
tokens.usage: Border of the PASS verdict banner.

tokens.name: banner-warn-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the warn banner.

tokens.name: banner-warn-text
tokens.usage: Warn banner text on banner-warn-bg (4.9:1).

tokens.name: banner-error-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the error banner and the FAIL verdict.

tokens.name: banner-error-text
tokens.usage: Error banner and FAIL verdict text on banner-error-bg (5.7:1).

tokens.name: banner-error-border
tokens.usage: Border of the FAIL verdict banner.

tokens.name: verdict-idle-text
tokens.usage: IDLE verdict text ("awaiting inputs") on banner-info-bg: 4.5:1. Was #6b7785 (4.1:1).

tokens.name: verdict-idle-border
tokens.usage: Border of the IDLE verdict banner.

tokens.name: port-rated-point
tokens.usage: Port colour for RatedPoint signals.

tokens.name: port-fluid-spec
tokens.usage: Port colour for FluidSpec signals.

tokens.name: port-test-point-set
tokens.usage: Port colour for TestPointSet signals.

tokens.name: port-corrected-curve
tokens.usage: Port colour for CorrectedCurve signals.

tokens.name: port-fitted-model
tokens.usage: Port colour for FittedModel signals.

tokens.name: port-compliance-result
tokens.usage: Port colour for ComplianceResult signals.

tokens.name: port-branch-bundle
tokens.usage: Port colour for BranchBundle signals and the fallback for any unmapped signal type.

tokens.name: port-ring
tokens.usage: Ring drawn around every port, and the fill of an unconnected port.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Idle connection between nodes, on canvas-bg.

tokens.name: edge-active
tokens.usage: Connection that is selected or carrying fresh data.

tokens.name: chart-head
tokens.usage: Head curve and points (Performance Plot, Explore Chart series 1).

tokens.name: chart-power
tokens.usage: Power curve and points (series 2).

tokens.name: chart-efficiency
tokens.usage: Efficiency curve and points (series 3).

tokens.name: chart-npsh
tokens.usage: NPSHr curve and NPSH3 test points.

tokens.name: chart-npsha
tokens.usage: NPSHa line on the NPSH chart.

tokens.name: chart-series-4
tokens.usage: Explore Chart series 4.

tokens.name: chart-series-5
tokens.usage: Explore Chart series 5; also ad-hoc Point markers.

tokens.name: chart-series-6
tokens.usage: Explore Chart series 6.

tokens.name: chart-marker-edge
tokens.usage: Outline and label of ad-hoc Point markers.

tokens.name: chart-ink
tokens.usage: Axis labels, rated-point crosshair, hover cursor and readouts on charts.

tokens.name: chart-tick
tokens.usage: Tick labels.

tokens.name: chart-frame
tokens.usage: Plot frame and value-label boxes.

tokens.name: chart-title
tokens.usage: Chart titles.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines of screen charts.

tokens.name: chart-cursor
tokens.usage: Vertical cursor line in the Explore Chart.

tokens.name: chart-state-point
tokens.usage: Current-state marker on the Fluid property chart.

tokens.name: chart-state-point-edge
tokens.usage: Outline of chart-state-point.

tokens.name: print-ink
tokens.usage: Annex M charts (Figures M.3 / M.4): curves, axes, callouts, as on the printed form.

tokens.name: print-text
tokens.usage: Annex M header values.

tokens.name: print-grid-major
tokens.usage: Annex M dotted major grid.

tokens.name: print-grid-minor
tokens.usage: Annex M dotted minor grid.

tokens.name: print-measured
tokens.usage: Annex M Figure M.4: measured vibration (curve 6).

tokens.name: print-test-point
tokens.usage: Annex M Figure M.4: test-point stars.

tokens.name: print-limit
tokens.usage: Annex M Figure M.4: vibration limits (3 and 4).

tokens.name: report-text
tokens.usage: Body text of the HTML report (16.9:1 on report-bg).

tokens.name: report-bg
tokens.usage: Page background of the HTML report.

tokens.name: report-heading
tokens.usage: Section headings and their rule in the HTML report (11.7:1).

tokens.name: report-subtitle
tokens.usage: Report subtitle (9.7:1).

tokens.name: report-muted
tokens.usage: Report date line (5.7:1).

tokens.name: report-caption
tokens.usage: Figure captions (7.5:1).

tokens.name: report-quote
tokens.usage: Quoted notes (12.6:1).

tokens.name: report-rule
tokens.usage: Table cell borders and the quote bar.

tokens.name: report-head-bg
tokens.usage: Table header cells.

tokens.name: report-kv-bg
tokens.usage: Label column of key/value tables.

families.mono: Consolas, Menlo, "DejaVu Sans Mono", "Courier New", monospace

styles.name: welcome-title
styles.usage: Product name in the welcome header, title-text on title-bg.

styles.name: dialog-title
styles.usage: Property dialog title (code asks for 12 pt DemiBold) in title-text on title-bg.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default for every widget: labels, inputs, tables, buttons, menus.

styles.name: button-primary
styles.usage: Primary button label, white on accent.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: API 610 Pump Performance Workbench — Factory Acceptance Test
styles.usage: Dialog and welcome subtitles in header-subtitle.

styles.name: banner
styles.usage: Status banner text (info, ok, warn, error).

styles.name: unit
styles.usage: Unit labels beside inputs, in unit-label.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Section headings in dialogs, in steel.

styles.name: welcome-section-label
styles.usage: Section headings on the welcome dialog, in steel.

styles.name: node-title
styles.usage: Node title bars (9 pt DemiBold) in title-text.

styles.name: node-body
styles.usage: Port labels and rows inside a node (8 pt).

styles.name: mono-block
styles.usage: Coefficients and pump lists in mono-text on mono-bg.

styles.name: node-mono
styles.usage: Numeric readouts painted on the canvas (8 pt).

tokens.name: space-header-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between dialog title and subtitle.

tokens.name: space-control-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding inside inputs (QLineEdit, spin boxes, combos).

tokens.name: space-control-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside inputs; also banner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-row
tokens.usage: Gap between a label, its field and its unit in a form row.

tokens.name: space-banner-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of status banners and tool buttons.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked blocks in a dialog body.

tokens.name: space-dialog-top
tokens.usage: Top padding of dialog header and body.

tokens.name: space-dialog-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of a dialog body.

tokens.name: space-dialog-x
tokens.usage: Left/right padding of dialog header and body; verdict banner horizontal padding.

tokens.usage: Checkbox indicator.

tokens.name: radius-scrollbar
tokens.usage: Scrollbar handle.

tokens.name: radius-control

tokens.name: radius-banner
tokens.usage: Status banners, mono blocks, recent/example rows; dialog header top corners.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Toolbox items and tables.

tokens.name: radius-node
tokens.usage: Canvas nodes and the verdict banner.

tokens.name: radius-welcome
tokens.usage: Welcome dialog frame.

tokens.name: node-width
tokens.usage: Width of every canvas node.

tokens.name: node-title-height
tokens.usage: Height of a node's title bar.

tokens.name: node-row-height
tokens.usage: Height of each port row in a node.

tokens.name: port-radius
tokens.usage: Radius of a port disc.

tokens.usage: Pitch of the canvas dot grid.
